title: Direct Renewal Offer, Conversion and Term Expiry — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
**Offer.** Bridgewell extends a direct renewal offer to the buyer under a Real Estate Service Contracts plan the plan's conversion offer period, in calendar days, before the term end date, for the Homeowner Service Contracts tier named as the plan's conversion tier, priced under the Homeowner Service Contracts premium rules.

**Acceptance.** A conversion is processed only on the buyer's own acceptance of the direct renewal offer, as stated by the buyer for the contract concerned.

**Effect of acceptance, by timing.**

| Buyer accepts | Result |
|---|---|
| before the term end date | the contract converts at term end with continuous coverage |
| after the term ended, within the continuity window set by the Homeowner Service Contracts enrollment terms | the contract converts |
| later than that window | a new homeowner enrollment with a waiting period |

A conversion creates a homeowner service contract, recorded as enrolled through real estate conversion, for the same customer and address.

**No acceptance.** A buyer who does not accept sees the contract expire at the end of the term end date.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a plan whose conversion offer period is 60 days and whose term end date is 14 June, the direct renewal offer is extended on 15 April.
